name: GHKM — fossil-flow emissions, productivity damages, knowledge-in-production (closed-form linear + 1-D robust f(Y) ODE)
summary: Process: emissions are a FLOW input choice — dirty output Y_d = A_d e^{-gamma0-gamma1 Y} K_d^{1-nu}(chi_F F)^{nu}, dY = thetabar eta0 F dt (+ varsigma eta0 F dW_y), carbon is burned fuel, capital does not emit; damages are log-linear PRODUCTIVITY damages on the dirty sector only (they strangle both dirty consumption and dirty investment I_d = s_d Y_d); knowledge is a Romer PRODUCTION input in the green sector Y_g = A_g K_g^{1-beta}(chi R)^{beta}, R&D funded from green output (I_r = s_r Y_g), log-log adjustment technology; tech breakthrough at CONSTANT hazard varpi_g = R0/varrho = 0.015 lifting A_g -> 0.1567, damage jump at constant hazard varpi_n = J_n(2.0) = 0.069 revealing gamma1^l = gamma1 + kappa lambda3(l). Coupling story: the GHKT flat-SCC tradition — constant optimal warming rate muY* = nu delta/gamma1 = 0.02, fossil use cut discretely at damage revelation, mitigation intensifying as the economy grows. Corrections: (a) MANDATORY critique fix adopted — the xi = infinity damage-jump shortcut replaced by the ansatz V = a_d logK_d + a_g logK_g + a_r logR + f(Y) + c in PRE-damage regimes; the robust damage-jump exponential depends on Y only, so f solves a verified 1-D nonlinear ODE, restoring genuine logxi geometry in the lifted pre-damage nets; (b) the critique's OPTIONAL affine-hazard re-coupling is REJECTED after verification: an affine hazard enters only pre-tech coefficient matching, forcing pre/post slope gaps that make the jump term state-dependent and quadratic — the closed form does not survive; we keep the constant hazard and carry R&D's activeness through knowledge-in-production (a_r = 0.198 > 0, nontrivial i_r field), documenting the i_r-breakthrough decoupling as a theory feature; (c) diffusion + tech-jump robustness exact in closed form (g'' = e^{-Delta_c/xi} constant); (d) the fossil control F has no production-net counterpart — documented, its effect is embodied in v and i_d.
solution_formulas: Coefficients (tech-invariant, hence constant tech gap Delta_c): a_d = delta theta_d(1-nu)/(delta + Gamma_d nu) = 0.085, a_g = theta_g(1-beta)(delta+Gamma_r)/D = 0.462, a_r = theta_g beta(delta+Gamma_g)/D = 0.198, D = delta + Gamma_g beta + Gamma_r(1-beta) = 0.07, identity a_g + a_r = theta_g; V_logK = a_d + a_g = 0.547. Shares: s_d = Gamma_d(1-nu)/(Gamma_d+delta) = 0.60, s_g = Gamma_g(1-beta)/(Gamma_g+delta) = 0.60, s_r = Gamma_r beta/(Gamma_r+delta) = 0.257 (constants; calibration theta_d = 0.34, beta = nu = 0.3, gamma1 = 0.15, chi = K_g0/R0, chi_F = K_d0/F0). Post-damage regimes fully LINEAR: p^l = -gamma1^l m, m = theta_d(Gamma_d+delta)/(delta+Gamma_d nu) = 0.85; fossil from the robust quadratic FOC delta theta_d nu/F + p^l thetabar eta0 - (1/xi)(p^l)^2 varsigma^2 eta0^2 F = 0 (positive root; xi = inf gives F* = nu delta/(gamma1^l thetabar eta0)). Pre-damage regimes: f(Y) 1-D ODE on Y in [0,4] (200 nodes, damped-Newton collocation): 0 = -delta f - delta m gamma1_pre Y + f' thetabar eta0 F(Y) + (varsigma^2 eta0^2 F(Y)^2/2) f'' - (1/2xi) f'^2 varsigma^2 eta0^2 F(Y)^2 + xi varpi_n Sum_l (1/5)[1 - e^{-(p^l Y + c^l - f(Y) - c_pre)/xi}] + (tech-jump term, see order), with F(Y) the pointwise positive root of the same FOC with p -> f'(Y). Solve order (all linear or 1-D): PostD-PostT (linear, per l) -> PostD-PreT (linear; constant tech gap Delta_c, robust premium P_g = xi(1-e^{-Delta_c/xi})) -> PreD-PostT (f_2(Y) ODE, damage jump into the linear PostD-PostT family) -> PreD-PreT (f_1(Y) ODE, damage jump into PostD-PreT + tech-jump term xi varpi_g[1 - e^{-((f_2 - f_1)(Y) + c_2 - c_1)/xi}], a Y-only function — exactness preserved). c-constants by backward recursion; normalization f(0) = 0.
lift_map: States map bijectively: logK_d = logK + log(1-Z), logK_g = logK + logZ, logR and Y shared. Value: v(x) = a_d[logK + log(1-Z)] + a_g[logK + logZ] + a_r logR + {p^l Y (post-damage) | f_reg(Y; xi) (pre-damage)} + c_reg(xi, l); lambda3 analytic via gamma1^l; logxi GENUINE via f(Y; xi), F*(xi), c(xi), P_g(xi) (tabulated on the logxi grid, splined). Post-tech production nets lack logR: collapse at the mean-reverting attractor gap* of logK_g - logR (closed-form constant), substituting a_r(logK + logZ - gap*) — documented, including that the economy's still-active post-tech s_r is embedded in v rather than lifted as a net. Policies at any input: i_d(x) = s_d A_d e^{-gamma0 - gamma1^reg Y}(chi_F F*)^{nu} e^{-nu(logK + log(1-Z))} — exponentially declining in Y and in dirty scale; i_g(x) = s_g A_g chi^{beta} e^{beta(logR - logK - logZ)}; i_r-net(x) = s_r A_g chi^{beta} Z^{1-beta} e^{beta(logR - logK)} — NONTRIVIAL in Z, logR, logK, both pre-tech regimes (i_r(x0) = 0.0195, production order). Feasibility guard applies box-wide; FOC-consistent fallback available if corners breach the production budget.
plots: (1) Comparative statics: (a_d, a_g, a_r, p) and (s_d, s_g, s_r, F*) versus beta and versus gamma1 across the four regimes, with the discrete fossil cut at damage revelation. (2) Lifted fields: i_d surface over (Y, logK) at Z = 0.7 (damage-strangulation decline) and i_r heatmap over (Z, logR - logK); f(Y; xi) curves per xi showing the restored logxi geometry. (3) 100-year simulated paths with jumps at hazard: logK_d, logK_g, logR, implied Z_t, Y_t, F_t, overlaid on the RUNA reference.
